_comment: Hand-labeled resume/requirement pairs. Each case states what a hiring manager would say about that requirement given that resume. The first 24 cases (backend, frontend and data resumes) are the development set the thresholds were originally fitted to. The 53 cases on the devops, ml, design and fullstack resumes were written before any threshold was fitted to them and form the held-out set. All labels are from a single annotator.

resumes.backend_fresher:
PROJECTS
Campus Payments Service
- Built a REST API in Express with JWT auth serving 1200 students
- Containerised the service with Docker and deployed it through GitHub Actions
- Wrote 40 unit tests taking coverage to 82%
INTERNSHIP
Backend Intern, Nexlify (May-July 2026)
- Cut a report query from 1.4s to 90ms by adding a composite index in MySQL
SKILLS
Python, Java, Kubernetes, Redis, Git, Linux
resumes.frontend_fresher:
PROJECTS
Canteen Ordering App
- Built a food ordering website for the college canteen using React
- Worked on the frontend and connected it to a database
- Handled login and signup for users
INTERNSHIP
Web Development Intern, Nexlify (May-July 2026)
- Helped the team with website tasks
- Fixed bugs reported by the senior developer
SKILLS
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Python, C++, MySQL, Git
resumes.data_fresher:
PROJECTS
Movie Recommendation System
- Built a collaborative filtering recommender on 10k ratings reaching 0.89 RMSE
- Used pandas and scikit-learn to train and evaluate the model
EDUCATION
B.Tech CSE 2027, CGPA 8.4
SKILLS
Python, SQL, Tableau, Excel, Git
resumes.devops_fresher:
PROJECTS
CI Pipeline for Student Portal
- Set up a Jenkins pipeline that builds, tests and deploys the portal on every merge, cutting release time from 2 hours to 15 minutes
- Wrote Terraform modules to provision 3 EC2 instances and an S3 bucket
- Configured Prometheus and Grafana dashboards tracking latency and error rate
INTERNSHIP
Cloud Intern, Zeta Systems (Jun-Aug 2026)
- Migrated 6 services to Docker containers on AWS ECS
- Automated nightly database backups with a Bash script, saving 5 hours per week
SKILLS
Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, Python, Git, Azure
resumes.ml_fresher:
PROJECTS
Sentiment Classifier for Product Reviews
- Fine-tuned a DistilBERT model on 25k reviews reaching 91% accuracy
- Built a preprocessing pipeline with NLTK and spaCy
Crop Disease Detection
- Trained a CNN in PyTorch on 12k leaf images, improving F1 from 0.71 to 0.84
- Deployed the model behind a Flask API used in a campus demo
INTERNSHIP
Data Science Intern, Orbit Analytics (May-Jul 2026)
- Reduced churn model error by 12% through feature engineering in pandas and scikit-learn
- Presented weekly findings to a team of 8
SKILLS
Python, SQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Tableau, Docker, Git
resumes.design_fresher:
PROJECTS
Campus Bus Tracker Redesign
- Redesigned the bus tracker app in Figma, cutting steps to find a route from 6 to 3
- Ran usability tests with 14 students and fixed the 5 most reported issues
- Built a component library of 30 reusable elements
Portfolio Website
- Developed a responsive portfolio in HTML, CSS and JavaScript
INTERNSHIP
UI Design Intern, Pixelcraft (Jun-Aug 2026)
- Designed 12 mobile screens for a fintech onboarding flow
- Worked with developers to ship the flow
SKILLS
Figma, Adobe XD, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Photoshop, Illustrator
resumes.fullstack_fresher:
PROJECTS
Expense Tracker
- Built a full-stack app with React and Node.js serving 300 users
- Designed a PostgreSQL schema with 8 tables and added indexes that cut dashboard load from 2s to 400ms
- Implemented JWT authentication with refresh tokens
- Wrote integration tests with Jest covering 70% of the API
Chat Application
- Added real-time messaging with WebSockets
INTERNSHIP
Software Intern, Brightlane (May-Jul 2026)
- Fixed 20 bugs and shipped 3 features in a React codebase
- Reviewed 15 pull requests on GitHub
SKILLS
JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS, Git
